turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Sam calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will follow up with the details.

turns.text: I'll try to pay 352 the 2nd.

turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $351.59 on September 2. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Will paying through the app or online banking?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can you with today?

turns.speaker: agent
